author: SickProdigy
UltimatePancake
description: Post configurable random dad jokes from icanhazdadjoke.com to a Discord channel.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores guild-level dad joke scheduler settings such as channel ID, interval, enablement, and next run time. It does not persistently store user data or metadata.
install_msg: Use `[p]dadjoke` or `[p]dadjokes` to get one dad joke, or configure scheduled posts with `[p]dadjokeset channel`, `[p]dadjokeset interval`, and `[p]dadjokeset enable`.
name: DadJokes
